subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first, and which parts should move to existing plugin/context-engine trackers?
rationale: Current main partially covers AGENTS.md bootstrap relevance and has compaction/context-engine/plugin hooks, but choosing a generic relevance algorithm or promoting observation extraction into core requires maintainer architecture direction.

options.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
options.body: Create or confirm separate trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then use this issue only as the linking umbrella.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as a broad architecture discussion and block automated repair work until maintainers prioritize one slice.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers confirm narrower open items fully cover bootstrap and compaction while observation extraction stays outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Focused Tracks
recommendation.body: Create or confirm separate trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then use this issue only as the linking umbrella.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the maintainer-style review on this issue and has relevant history on the affected bootstrap/runtime paths.
